name: US equity stress
summary: VIX near 21 above Watch line; S&P 500 3.2% off high as chip stocks rebound
state: The VIX closed near 20.8 on 3 Nov, above the 20 Watch line, and the S&P 500 is about 3.2% below its 52-week high. On 3 Nov the S&P 500 and Nasdaq ended three-day losing streaks as chip stocks rallied, while the Dow slipped (Yahoo Finance). Midterm results, the Bank of England (5 Nov) and US payrolls (6 Nov) are the next tests.
for_you: Volatility is elevated but below stress levels. Pensions and funds with US technology exposure are most sensitive to swings.
rubric_hit: VIX 18.2 has not yet cleared the 18 exit line, so Watch holds

sources.title: Yahoo Finance — S&P 500, Nasdaq snap 3-day losing streaks as chip stocks rally

why: The S&P 500 is the world's risk barometer; sharp falls and spiking volatility transmit to pensions, credit and confidence globally.
drivers: Earnings, interest-rate expectations, liquidity, geopolitical shocks, positioning and leverage.

rubric.alert: VIX > 30, or drawdown > 15%, or a market-wide circuit breaker trips.
rubric.normal: VIX < 20 and S&P 500 drawdown from 52-week high < 5%.
